Name: Vanguard
Theme: Shield-bearers who hold the line: taunt, guard an ally, shove and stomp, rally the party behind them.

Name: Blade
Theme: Weapon masters of sword and spear: probe, parry, counter, then one decisive cut.

Name: Brawn
Theme: Fists, clubs and rage: chained combos, staggers and reckless swings that trade blood for damage.

Name: Shadow
Theme: Thieves, ninjas and blurs: vanish, flank, strike the opening and be gone before the reply.

Name: Wild
Theme: Beasts and the ones who hunt beside them: roars, pack rallies, tamed monsters, snares and shots from afar.

Name: Machina
Theme: Builders of the battlefield: mines, turrets, drones, ward grids and field repairs.

Name: Arcane
Theme: Mind over the fight: raw spells and spellblades, and the tempo weavers who bend who acts when.

Name: Occult
Theme: Blood, curses and the dark: hexes that fester, drains that feed, and knights sworn to the night.

Name: Grace
Theme: Menders of every stripe: wards, cleanses, heals given at a run and harm turned into hope.
